description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the AWS Billing and Cost Management Pricing Calculator service, including method annotations for various API operations.

classes.name: BCMPricingCalculatorClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient to communicate with the AWS Billing and Cost Management Pricing Calculator service.

methods.description: Creates a request to batch modify bill scenario commitments.

methods.name: batchCreateBillScenarioCommitmentModificationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a request to batch modify bill scenario commitments.

methods.name: batchCreateBillScenarioUsageModification
methods.description: Creates a request to batch modify bill scenario usage.

methods.name: batchCreateBillScenarioUsageModificationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a request to batch modify bill scenario usage.

methods.name: batchCreateWorkloadEstimateUsage

methods.description: Asynchronously creates a request to batch create workload estimate usage.

methods.name: batchDeleteBillScenarioUsageModification

methods.name: batchDeleteBillScenarioUsageModificationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes batch bill scenario usage modifications.

methods.name: batchDeleteWorkloadEstimateUsageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes batch workload estimate usage.

methods.description: Batch updates bill scenario commitment modifications.

methods.name: batchUpdateBillScenarioCommitmentModificationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously batch updates bill scenario commitment modifications.

methods.name: batchUpdateBillScenarioUsageModification
methods.description: Batch updates bill scenario usage modifications.

methods.name: batchUpdateBillScenarioUsageModificationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously batch updates bill scenario usage modifications.

methods.name: batchUpdateWorkloadEstimateUsageAsync
